metadata.notes: All facts self-reported; decision rules are qualitative summaries, not validated parameters.

consumption.frequency: One energy drink or one serving of pre-workout each morning, typically before workout
consumption.daily_limit: No more than one energy drink per day
consumption.rest_effect: Attempts to keep caffeine intake similar regardless of rest
consumption.other_caffeine: Generally none beyond morning energy drink or pre-workout
skip_conditions: Out of supply at home and insufficient time to purchase elsewhere
consumption.at_home_supply_effect: Usually consumes each morning if stocked

flavor_preferences.exceptions: Orange or grape blended with other flavors acceptable

product_preferences.fallback: C4 commonly available at convenience stores and gas stations
product_preferences.brand_exploration: Previously explored brands; now rarely tries unfamiliar brands

purchase_channels: Gas station or convenience store when away from home
economics.purchase_style: Pre-workout tubs or canned multipacks, rarely individual cans
economics.serving_adjustment: May use less than full scoop when full serving contains 300 mg caffeine

price_increase_25pct.preworkout: Likely continue Ghost due to usefulness and many servings
price_increase_25pct.cans: Likely switch among Ghost and other liked brands

price_decrease_50pct.response: Would continue purchasing the favorite brand if its price decreased by 50%.
price_decrease_50pct.interpretation: Clarified directly by respondent on 2026-11-03; the original response mistakenly referred to a price increase.

promotions.bulk_multipack: Large quantity advantages can prompt switching brands

economics.lower_budget: Would continue buying but weigh price more heavily; zero sugar and label transparency remain requirements
economics.convenience: Will not go out of way to buy a drink; may skip if rushed

behavioral_factors.brand_ethics: Would switch from a liked brand if it supported something strongly opposed or genuinely harmed a community
behavioral_factors.health_attitude: Feels uneasy about health effects but currently values workout and early-day energy benefits
behavioral_factors.advertising: Brand promotion alone not identified as primary driver
behavioral_factors.inventory: Stocking at home increases consistency of consumption

suggested_sequence: Check whether home supply is available
Check morning workout context and time constraints
Compare effectiveness, flavor, caffeine dose, and serving economics
Consider convenience and brand ethical concerns
Choose pre-workout, canned energy drink, or skip
decision_guidance.warning: These are qualitative summaries, not empirically estimated decision probabilities.

uncertainties: Exact count of recent purchases by product
Whether one scoop refers to full or partial serving on a given day
Observed response to actual price changes
